units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:2">Num. R. s. 7</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 14:11">Num. XIV, 11</cite> <he>בקרבו</he>) <he>אטר אעשה עמו … בקרבו כמה … עשיתי בקִרְבֵּיהֶן וכ׳</he> it does not read, ‘which I do with them’, but ‘which I do within them’:… how many signs and wonders have I done in their intestines (that the manna was entirely resorbed in their bowels) &c. (with ref. to <cite ref="S01885"><he>קֶרֶב</he></cite> <cite ref="Leviticus 8:21">Lev. VIII, 21</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:2:3">Y. Sabb. II, 4ᵈ</cite> <he>ק׳ דגים כל זמן וכ׳</he> the fat of fish entrails (used as oil) has no bad odor as long as it burns.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b">B. Mets. 60ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01025"><he>נָפַח</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 54b:3">Ned. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ לאו בשר וכ׳</he> entrails are no meat and he who eats them is no man; Y. ib. VII, beg. 40ᵇ <cite ref="S01895"><he>קרבייא</he></cite> (ch. form).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> <he>בְּקִרְבַּנוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="T00540"><he>רָחַשׁ</he></cite>; a. e.
